name: erb-b2 receptor tyrosine kinase 4

function.text: ERBB4 encodes receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-4 [Cleaved into: ERBB4 intracellular domain]. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

function.text: ERBB4 encodes receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-4. It is a tyrosine-protein kinase that plays an essential role as cell surface receptor for neuregulins and EGF family members and regulates development of the heart, the central nervous system and the mammary gland, gene transcription, cell proliferation, differentiation, migration and apoptosis. It is required for normal cardiac muscle differentiation during embryonic development, and for postnatal cardiomyocyte proliferation. It is required for normal development of the embryonic central nervous system, especially for normal neural crest cell migration and normal axon guidance.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ERBB4 have been reported in melanoma, cholangiocarcinoma, and stomach adenocarcinoma.
